verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is generic. LegalZoom offers access to 150+ customizable legal documents and unlimited 30-minute attorney consults, and it notes that corporations can offer stock to investors. None of these items names offer letters, confidentiality/IP assignment agreements, or option grants. Missing for 10: explicit offer-letter templates, confidentiality/IP agreement templates, stock option grant/equity plan paperwork, any workflow for running hiring paperwork through the platform, independent corroboration.
